method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Worst of US Inflation May Be Over If Iran Peace Deal Sticks
Equities.reason: Major geopolitical de‑risking (Iran peace framework) could lower energy risk premia and ease US inflation expectations — supportive for equities via lower yields and improved liquidity; important macro transmission.

Equities.title: Oil tumbles on US-Iran deal framework: How one trader is playing the move
Equities.summary: Airline stocks are rallying Monday and the U.S. Global Jets ETF (JETS) is on the verge of a new high for the year.
Equities.reason: Oil decline from a Hormuz reopening triggers sector rotation into travel/cyclicals (airlines) and boosts risk‑on sentiment — positive for broader equity cyclicals and reflation trades.

Equities.title: Companies Rush to Borrow Cash as US-Iran Deal Spurs Bullish Mood
Equities.reason: Corporate issuance demand rising as firms tap markets amid improved sentiment — indicates liquidity unlocking and risk appetite that supports equities and potential buybacks/M&A activity.

Equities.title: Indian shares set to extend gains on US-Iran peace deal
Equities.reason: Regional equity markets (India) receiving positive spillover from global de‑risking — supports EM equities and indicates cross‑border flow into risk assets.

Equities.title: Wall Street's fear gauge tumbles as traders bid up SpaceX shares
Equities.summary: The biggest IPO has been digested without a hiccup, and Wall Street's so-called "fear gauge" is back below its long-term average.
Equities.reason: Drop in volatility (VIX) and buoyant IPO demand signal a stronger risk‑on regime; positive for equities sentiment and momentum-driven leadership.

Equities.title: SpaceX set to extend rally after record Wall Street debut
Equities.reason: Historic, highly visible IPO injecting fresh liquidity and retail/ETF interest into markets; amplifies risk‑on flows and supports market breadth and sentiment.

Equities.title: Nvidia plans to raise at least $20 billion in its first debt sale since start of AI boom
Equities.summary: Nvidia is set to raise capital in a debt sale for the first time since 2021, when the chipmaker was a fraction of its current size.
Equities.reason: Large corporate financing by the market leader underscores confidence in the AI cycle and funds growth/capex — supportive for AI/semiconductor leadership and related equities.

Equities.title: Anthropic to meet with Trump administration over Mythos dispute
Equities.summary: Anthropic received an export control directive that ordered the company to suspend access to its latest AI models by any foreign national.
Equities.reason: Regulatory/export controls on a major AI player are a direct headwind to the AI leadership narrative and could dent sentiment and near‑term multiples for AI‑exposed equities.

Equities.title: China economy weakens further in May as retail sales post first drop in over three years
Equities.summary: China's retail sales fell for the first time in more than three years in May, while urban investment contracted more than expected, adding to signs the economic slump deepened.
Equities.reason: Persistent China demand weakness is a meaningful drag on global growth expectations and commodity demand, constraining cyclicals and EM equity upside.

Equities.title: China’s Property Stocks Tumble Back to Pre-2024 Stimulus Levels
Equities.reason: Further stress in China property names highlights ongoing domestic balance‑sheet and demand issues — a targeted negative for China‑exposed equities and commodity sectors.

Equities.title: BlackRock’s Rieder Sees ‘Explosive’ Rally as Cash Gets Unlocked
Equities.reason: Large‑asset manager commentary about unlocked cash amplifies the bullish liquidity narrative; supports continued flows into equities and risk assets.

Rates.title: Japan Raises Rates to 31-Year High to Ward Off War Inflation
Rates.reason: Major BOJ rate hike to 1% is a regime shift for JGBs and global rates — increases yield expectations and risks a broad bond selloff; high relevance to rates markets.

Rates.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 1% for first time since 1995
Rates.summary: Central bank says it will stop reducing level of monthly bond purchases from next year
Rates.reason: BOJ hike and guidance to stop tapering reductions of monthly purchases tightens policy and signals less JGB demand from the BOJ — negative for bond prices and central to rates narrative.

Rates.title: Bank of Japan hikes interest rate by 25 bps to 1% as expected
Rates.summary: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) announced on Tuesday that it increased the short-term interest rate by 25 basis points (bps) to 1% after concluding the two-day monetary policy review meeting.
Rates.reason: Confirmation of the BOJ 25bp hike — direct, high-signal policy move that lifts short-end yields and pressures JGB prices.

Rates.title: Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations
Rates.reason: Operational change to money-market guideline following the policy review affects liquidity provision and market functioning — supportive of higher short-term yields and JGB volatility.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026)
Rates.reason: BOJ's outright purchase schedule provides direct information on future JGB demand from the central bank — tightening or changes reduce BOJ backstop and are negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Asia markets temper Iran deal optimism, BOJ hikes rates
Rates.reason: Links BOJ hike to regional/global market moves — underscores the immediate spillover of higher JGB yields into Asian/EM fixed income and global rate repricing.

Rates.title: Australia central bank warns hikes are not off the table as it keeps rates steady at 4.35%
Rates.summary: In its statement, the RBA said that inflation was "still too high," which warranted to keep the cash rate unchanged
Rates.reason: RBA pause but hawkish language keeps the door open for further hikes — mildly negative for Australian and global bond prices (higher-for-longer signal).

Rates.title: US Asset Manager PGIM Flips Fed View, Sees Three Hikes This Year
Rates.reason: A major asset manager moving to a hawkish Fed-hike view raises odds of higher US yields — important market-forecaster signal for Treasury markets.

Rates.title: Warsh's Fed is likely to hold rates steady — what the leadership change could mean for your money
Rates.summary: The Federal Reserve's June meeting, the first helmed by new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, may impact many consumer borrowing and savings rates down the road.
Rates.reason: Report that the new Fed Chair may hold rates steady is a counter-signal that could support bond prices in the near term; lower relevance vs. direct policy actions.

Rates.title: Citadel Securities Warns Higher Rates to Challenge Risk Assets
Rates.reason: Market-pro player warning underscores expectations of higher-for-longer rates and potential pressure on fixed income and risk assets — supportive of a cautious rates narrative.

Rates.title: Chinese Bonds Draw Foreign Funds in May After a Year of Outflows
Rates.reason: Increased foreign demand for Chinese bonds is supportive for bond prices (lower yields) in that market and signals cross-border flows into fixed income that can offset some global tightening pressure.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index holds onto Monday’s gains near 99.70 ahead of Fed’s policy
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) trades firmly near Monday’s high ahead of the start of the two-day Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy meeting, whose decision will be announced on Wednesday.
FX.reason: USD firm ahead of a major Fed meeting — clears the market narrative toward USD strength into the decision, material for FX flows and positioning.

FX.title: Bank of Japan hikes rates to 1%, highest since 1995, as yen and inflation worries take hold
FX.summary: This is the BOJ's first hike since December, when it raised rates to its current level of 0.75%, also its highest level in over 30 years.
FX.reason: Historic BoJ tightening is a major FX regime shock — lifts JPY materially vs. peers and changes carry/yield dynamics across Asian/JPY crosses.

FX.title: Japanese Yen remains stronger as BoJ delivers a rate hike
FX.summary: USD/JPY depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 160.10 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair remains subdued as the Japanese Yen (JPY) holds ground following the release of the interest rate decision by the Bank of Japan (BoJ).
FX.reason: Market reaction confirming JPY appreciation after the BoJ hike — direct FX impact on USD/JPY and broader cross-asset flows.

FX.title: Yen Pares Gains Versus Dollar After BOJ Hikes Key Rate to 1%
FX.reason: Follow-on price action shows JPY gains partially faded after initial move — a moderate counter-signal that the JPY rally may be partially profit-taking or USD resilient.

FX.title: Euro edges higher to near 1.1600 on US-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1590 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. A deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz spurred a rally in riskier assets such as the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Geopolitical détente (Strait of Hormuz) triggered risk-on flows and EUR strength vs USD — relevant as a USD-weakness driver in the short run.

FX.title: Australian Dollar advances as Hormuz breakthrough sinks USD and Oil
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar registered gains of over 0.37% on Monday as the US and Iran agreed on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) aimed at ending the conflict and setting the stage for talks about Tehran’s nuclear program.
FX.reason: Risk-on/reduced oil-risk impulse lifting commodity-linked FX (AUD) and weighing on USD — a clear USD-weakness transmission channel.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as risk-off mood supports US Dollar
FX.summary: NZD/USD extends its losses for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.5810 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds steady amid broad market caution.
FX.reason: NZD weakness explicitly attributed to USD support during risk-off — reinforces the USD-holding-ground theme into Fed/geo events.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Struggles to return above 20-day EMA, eyes on Fed policy
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades marginally lower at around 1.1580 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The major currency pair drops as the US Dollar (USD) rises, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Technical note confirming EUR struggles vs USD ahead of the Fed — lower relevance (forecast/technical) but consistent with USD-strength narrative.

FX.title: British Pound inches lower amid market caution ahead of US-Iran deal updates
FX.summary: GBP/USD loses ground after registering minor gains in the previous day, trading around 1.3400 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair inches lower as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from the market caution ahead of further developments regarding US-Ir
FX.reason: GBP weakness attributed to USD support and market caution — relevant for G10 USD crosses ahead of policy/geopolitical updates.

FX.title: Swiss Franc declines as market caution lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CHF gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 0.7950 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds steady amid broad market caution.
FX.reason: CHF weakening explained by USD holding ground — supports the broader USD-strength/caution narrative across safe-haven crosses.

FX.title: Bitcoin traders have a reason to watch Tuesday's BOJ rate decision. Yen shorts are at a nine-year high
FX.reason: Positioning note (large yen short exposure) is relevant ahead of BoJ decision — raises squeeze risk and amplifies JPY move if the BoJ tightens, increasing FX volatility.

Commodities.title: Gold rises as US, Iran announce framework to end war
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) gains momentum during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The precious metal extends the rally after the United States (US) and Iran reached a comprehensive framework deal to end hostilities, easing inflation concerns.
Commodities.reason: US-Iran framework lowers geopolitical risk and eases inflation/hike fears — bullish for gold as a safe haven and real-rate hedge. Clear cross-market transmission (policy/real yields) makes this a relevant commodity story.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Gain as Trump Touts Reopening of Hormuz This Week
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg coverage reinforces the narrative that reduced Strait of Hormuz tensions (reopening talk) is supporting gold by lowering geopolitical risk premia and shifting Fed expectations — constructive for bullion.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD edges lower below $70.00 as bearish bias holds under 100-day SMA
Commodities.summary: Silver Price (XAG/USD) trades in negative territory around $69.85 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The white metal retreats from a weekly high as traders book some profits ahead of the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision.
Commodities.reason: Technical/near-term profit-taking ahead of the Fed is mildly bearish for silver; article is price-forecast/technical in nature so relevance is capped lower.

Commodities.title: WTI hovers around $80.00 as traders await developments on US-Iran peace talks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price inches higher after registering 3.7% losses in the previous day, trading around $80.10 per barrel during the Asian hours on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Price action shows modest easing of risk premium after recent losses; overall tone is close to neutral/slightly bearish as market awaits clarity on peace talks and supply implications.

Commodities.title: Middle East Oil Markets Weaken on Optimism Over Increased Supply
Commodities.reason: Authoritative take that reduced geopolitical risk/optimism about supply is lowering Middle East oil risk premia — material negative for oil prices and market risk premium.

Commodities.title: Oil: Hormuz risks keep supply outlook tense – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank’s Global Daily highlights that reported progress on a US-Iran understanding has not removed key risks around the Strait of Hormuz, with only a brief memorandum agreed and major details still unclear.
Commodities.reason: Rabobank flags that material supply risks remain around the Strait of Hormuz, supporting a risk premium for oil — a partial counterweight to optimism and therefore relevant to oil price direction.

Commodities.title: Higher blending targets drive RIN prices close to record highs
Commodities.summary: Compliance credits for biomass-based diesel and ethanol have doubled in value since the start of this year. The credits, known as renewable identification numbers (RINs), have increased in price, mostly because of higher U.S. biofuel blending targets. The comb
Commodities.reason: Higher RIN prices from bigger U.S. blending mandates increase costs for refiners and support gasoline/biofuel complex prices (RBOB) — a meaningful fundamentals-driven commodity signal.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin hits a two-week high above $65,500 as the US-Iran deal sends oil sliding
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical de‑escalation (US‑Iran deal) cut oil risk premium and drove risk‑on flows that lifted bitcoin; represents a macro risk‑on impulse supportive of crypto but is event‑specific, so moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Live markets: Bitcoin ETFs bled cash Monday while every other crypto ETF gained
Crypto.reason: ETF flows are a core liquidity/adoption signal. Rotation out of bitcoin ETFs into other crypto ETFs suggests diversification of inflows — mildly positive for broader crypto liquidity but mixed for BTC specifically.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin rises after Bank of Japan hikes interest rates to a 31-year high
Crypto.reason: Central‑bank tightening and higher yields are a broad headwind for risk assets and crypto. Even if BTC initially rose on the move, the dominant macro impulse from rate hikes is negative for crypto demand and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Profit-taking across bitcoin, ether, solana as traders wait on the Iran signing
Crypto.reason: Short‑term profit‑taking ahead of a major geopolitical signing is a near‑term negative for prices across major tokens; limited relevance as a transitory liquidity/volatility signal.

Crypto.title: Kraken debuts U.S. perpetual futures as crypto derivatives move onshore
Crypto.reason: On‑shore perpetual futures are a meaningful structural development: expands regulated derivatives access, improves institutional participation and liquidity — a clear positive for crypto markets and adoption.

Crypto.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy acquires another 1,587 bitcoin for $100 million
Crypto.reason: Corporate treasury purchases add direct, persistent demand for bitcoin and signal institutional confidence — supportive fundamental for BTC prices and market structure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin could crash to $48,000, if this historical pattern is triggered
Crypto.reason: Price‑forecast/technical‑pattern piece highlighting downside risk. Such stories can weigh on sentiment; by framework, technical price‑forecast articles get capped relevance.
